items.title: China
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: China, officially the People's Republic of China (PRC), is a country in East Asia. It is divided into 33 province-level divisions, including two special administrative regions.

items.title: India
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: India, officially the Republic of India, is a country in South Asia. It is the world's seventh-largest country by area and its most populous.

items.title: the United States
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The United States of America (USA), also known as the United States (U.S.) or America, is a country primarily located in North America.

items.title: Indonesia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Indonesia, officially the Republic of Indonesia, is a country in Southeast Asia and Oceania, between the Indian and Pacific oceans. Comprising between 13,000 and 17,000 islands, including Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, and parts of Borneo and New Guinea, it is the world's largest archipelagic state and the 14th-largest country by area.

items.title: Pakistan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Pakistan, officially the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, is a country in South Asia. It is the fifth-most populous country, with a population of over 241.5 million, having the second-largest Muslim population in the world as of 2023.

items.title: Brazil
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Brazil, officially the Federative Republic of Brazil, is the largest country in South America. It is also the world's fifth-largest country by area and the seventh-largest by population, with over 214 million people.

items.title: Nigeria
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Nigeria, officially the Federal Republic of Nigeria, is a country in West Africa between the Sahel to the north and the Gulf of Guinea in the Atlantic Ocean to the south. It covers an area of 923,769 square kilometres (356,669 mi2).

items.title: Bangladesh
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Bangladesh, officially the People's Republic of Bangladesh, is a country in South Asia. It is the eighth-most populous country in the world with a population of almost 177.8 million people within an area of 148,461 square kilometres (57,321 sq mi).

items.title: Russia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Russia, or the Russian Federation, is a country in Eastern Europe and North Asia. It is the largest country in the world, spanning eleven time zones and sharing land borders with fourteen countries.

items.title: Mexico
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Mexico, officially the United Mexican States, is a country in North America.

items.title: Japan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Japan is an island country in East Asia. Located in the Pacific Ocean off the northeast coast of the Asian mainland, it is bordered to the west by the Sea of Japan, the Sea of Okhotsk in the north, and the East China Sea in the south.

items.title: Ethiopia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ethiopia, officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (FDRE), is a landlocked country located in the Horn of Africa region of East Africa. It shares borders with Eritrea to the north, Djibouti to the northeast, Somalia to the southeast, Kenya to the south, South Sudan to the west, and Sudan to the northwest.

items.title: the Philippines
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The Philippines, officially the Republic of the Philippines, is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia. Located in the western Pacific Ocean, it consists of about 7,641 islands, with a total area of about 300,000 square kilometers.

items.title: Egypt
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Egypt, officially the Arab Republic of Egypt, is a country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and southwest corner of Asia via the Sinai Peninsula. It is bordered by the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Palestine and Israel to the northeast, the Red Sea to the east, Sudan and the Sahara to the south, and Libya to the west.

items.title: Vietnam
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Vietnam, officially the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam (SRV), is a country at the eastern edge of Mainland Southeast Asia. With an area of about 331,000 square kilometres and a population of over 102 million, it is the world's 16th-most populous country.

items.title: the Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), also known as the DR Congo, Congo-Kinshasa, or simply the Congo, and formerly named Zaire, is a country in Central Africa. By land area, it is the second-largest country in Africa and the eleventh-largest in the world.

items.title: Turkey
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Turkey, officially the Republic of Türkiye, is a country mainly located in Anatolia in West Asia, with a smaller part called East Thrace in Southeast Europe.

items.title: Germany
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Germany, officially the Federal Republic of Germany, is a country in Western and Central Europe. It lies between the Baltic Sea and the North Sea to the north with the Alps to the south.

items.title: Iran
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Iran, officially the Islamic Republic of Iran, and historically known as Persia, is a country in West Asia.

items.title: Thailand
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Thailand, officially the Kingdom of Thailand, and formerly known as Siam, is a country located in Mainland Southeast Asia. It shares land borders with Myanmar to the west and northwest, Laos to the east and northeast, Cambodia to the southeast, and Malaysia to the south.

items.title: France
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: France, officially the French Republic, is a country primarily located in Western Europe. Its overseas regions and territories include French Guiana in South America, Saint Pierre and Miquelon in the North Atlantic, the French West Indies, and many islands in Oceania and the Indian Ocean.

items.title: the United Kingdom
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, commonly known as the United Kingdom (UK) or Britain, is a country in Northwestern Europe, off the coast of the continental mainland. It comprises England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland, with a population of over 69 million in 2024.

items.title: Italy
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Italy, officially the Italian Republic, is a country in Southern and Western Europe. It consists of a peninsula, which extends into the Mediterranean Sea, with the Alps on its northern land border, as well as nearly 800 islands, notably Sicily and Sardinia.

items.title: South Africa
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: South Africa, officially the Republic of South Africa (RSA), is the southernmost country in Africa.

items.title: Tanzania

items.fact: Tanzania, officially the United Republic of Tanzania, is a country in East Africa within the African Great Lakes region.

items.title: Myanmar
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Myanmar, officially the Republic of the Union of Myanmar and also referred to as Burma (the official English name until 1989), is a country in northwest Southeast Asia. It is the largest country by area in Mainland Southeast Asia and has a population of about 55 million.

items.title: Kenya
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Kenya, officially the Republic of Kenya, is a country located in East Africa. With an estimated population of more than 54.2 million as of mid-2026, it is the 26th-most populous country in the world and the seventh-most populous in Africa.

items.title: South Korea
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: South Korea, officially the Republic of Korea (ROK), is a country in East Asia. It constitutes the southern half of the Korean Peninsula and borders North Korea along the Korean Demilitarized Zone, with the Yellow Sea to the west and the Sea of Japan to the east.

items.title: Colombia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Colombia, officially the Republic of Colombia, is a country located in South America, with insular regions in North America.

items.title: Spain
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Spain, officially the Kingdom of Spain, is a country in Southern and Western Europe with territories in North Africa. Featuring the southernmost point of continental Europe, it is the largest country in Southern Europe and the fourth-most populous European Union (EU) member state.

items.title: Argentina
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Argentina, officially the Argentine Republic, is a country in the far south of South America. It covers an area of 2,780,085 km2 (1,073,397 mi2), making it the second-largest country in South America after Brazil, the fourth-largest country in the Americas, and the eighth-largest country in the world.

items.title: Ukraine
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe. It is the second-largest country in Europe after Russia, which borders it to the east and northeast.

items.fact: Uganda, officially the Republic of Uganda, is a landlocked country in East Africa. It is bordered to the east by Kenya, to the north by South Sudan, to the west by the Democratic Republic of the Congo, to the south-west by Rwanda, and to the south by Tanzania.

items.title: Algeria
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Algeria, officially the People's Democratic Republic of Algeria, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. Spanning over 2,381,741 square kilometres (919,595 sq mi), it is the largest country in Africa and the tenth largest in the world.

items.title: Sudan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: Sudan, officially the Republic of the Sudan, is a country in Northeast Africa. It borders the Central African Republic to the southwest, Chad to the west, Libya to the northwest, Egypt to the north, the Red Sea to the east, Eritrea and Ethiopia to the southeast, and South Sudan to the south.

items.title: Iraq
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Iraq, officially the Republic of Iraq, is a country in West Asia. Located within the Middle East, it is bordered by Saudi Arabia to the south, Turkey to the north, Iran to the east, the Persian Gulf and Kuwait to the southeast, Jordan to the southwest, and Syria to the west.

items.title: Afghanistan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Afghanistan, officially the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, is a landlocked country located at the crossroads of Central and South Asia. It is bordered by Pakistan to the east and south, Iran to the west, Turkmenistan to the northwest, Uzbekistan to the north, Tajikistan to the northeast, and China to the northeast and east.

items.title: Poland
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Poland, officially the Republic of Poland, is a country in Central Europe. It extends from the Baltic Sea in the north to the Sudetes and Carpathian Mountains in the south, and borders Lithuania and Russia to the northeast; Belarus and Ukraine to the east; Slovakia and the Czech Republic to the south; and Germany to the west.

items.title: Canada
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Canada is a country in North America. Its ten provinces and three territories extend from the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean and northward into the Arctic Ocean, making it the second-largest country by total area, with the longest coastline of any country.

items.title: Morocco
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa.

items.title: Saudi Arabia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Saudi Arabia, officially the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), is a country in West Asia that occupies the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula. Covering a land area of approximately 2,149,690 km2 (830,000 sq mi), it is the fifth-largest country in Asia and the twelfth-largest in the world.

items.title: Uzbekistan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Uzbekistan, officially the Republic of Uzbekistan, is a sovereign, doubly landlocked country located in Central Asia. It is bordered by Kazakhstan to the north, Kyrgyzstan to the northeast, Tajikistan to the southeast, Afghanistan to the south, and Turkmenistan to the south-west.

items.title: Peru
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Peru, officially the Republic of Peru, is a country in western South America. It is bordered to the north by Ecuador and Colombia, to the east by Brazil, to the southeast by Bolivia, to the south by Chile, and to the south and west by the Pacific Ocean.

items.title: Malaysia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia. A federal constitutional monarchy, it consists of 13 states and three federal territories, separated by the South China Sea into two regions: Peninsular Malaysia on Mainland Southeast Asia and East Malaysia on the island of Borneo.

items.title: Angola
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: Angola, officially the Republic of Angola, is a country on the western coast of Southern Africa. It is the second-largest Portuguese-speaking (Lusophone) country after Brazil in both total area and population and is the seventh-largest country in Africa.

items.title: Ghana
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ghana, officially the Republic of Ghana, is a country in West Africa. It is situated with the Gulf of Guinea and the Atlantic Ocean to the south, and shares borders with Ivory Coast to the west, Burkina Faso to the north, and Togo to the east.

items.title: Mozambique
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Mozambique, officially the Republic of Mozambique, is a country in Southeast Africa bordered by the Indian Ocean to the east, Tanzania to the north, Malawi and Zambia to the northwest, Zimbabwe to the west, and Eswatini and South Africa to the south and southwest.

items.title: Yemen
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Yemen, officially the Republic of Yemen, is a country in West Asia. Located in southern Arabia, the country includes the Socotra Archipelago and borders Saudi Arabia to the north, Oman to the northeast, the Arabian Sea to the east, the Gulf of Aden to the south, and the Red Sea to the west.

items.title: Nepal
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Nepal, officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal, is a landlocked country in South Asia. It is mainly situated in the Himalayas, but also includes parts of the Indo-Gangetic Plain.

items.title: Venezuela
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Venezuela, officially the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela, is a country on the northern coast of South America, consisting of a continental landmass and various islands and islets in the Caribbean Sea. It comprises an area of 912,050 km2 (352,140 sq mi), with a population estimated at 31.8 million in 2025.

items.title: Madagascar
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Madagascar, officially the Republic of Madagascar, is an island country in the Indian Ocean that includes the island of Madagascar and numerous smaller peripheral islands. Lying off the southeastern coast of Africa, it is the world's fourth-largest island, the second-largest island country, and the 46th-largest country overall.

items.title: Cameroon
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Cameroon, officially the Republic of Cameroon, is a country in Central Africa. It shares boundaries with Nigeria to the west and north, Chad to the northeast, the Central African Republic to the east, and Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, and the Republic of the Congo to the south.

items.title: Ivory Coast
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ivory Coast, also known as Côte d'Ivoire and officially as the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, is a country on the southern coast of West Africa. Its capital city of Yamoussoukro is located in the centre of the country, while its largest city and economic centre is the port city of Abidjan.

items.title: North Korea
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: North Korea, officially the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK), is a country in East Asia. It constitutes the northern half of the Korean Peninsula and borders China and Russia to the north at the Yalu (Amnok) and Tumen rivers, and South Korea (officially the Republic of Korea) to the south at the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ).

items.title: Australia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Australia, officially the Commonwealth of Australia, is a country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania and numerous smaller islands. It has a land area of 7,688,287 km2 (2,968,464 sq mi), making it the sixth-largest country in the world, and is the world's flattest and driest inhabited continent.

items.title: Taiwan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Taiwan, officially the Republic of China (ROC), is a country in East Asia. The main island of Taiwan, formerly known as Formosa, lies between the East and South China Seas in the northwestern Pacific Ocean, with the People's Republic of China (PRC) to the northwest, Japan to the northeast, and the Philippines to the south.

items.title: Niger
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Niger, officially the Republic of the Niger, is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is a unitary state bordered by Libya to the northeast, Chad to the east, Nigeria to the south, Benin and Burkina Faso to the southwest, Mali to the west and Algeria to the northwest.

items.title: Sri Lanka
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Sri Lanka, officially the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, formerly known as Ceylon, is an island country in South Asia. It is located in the Indian Ocean, southwest of the Bay of Bengal, and is separated from India by the Gulf of Mannar and the Palk Strait.

items.title: Burkina Faso
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Burkina Faso is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is bordered by Mali to the northwest, Niger to the northeast, Benin to the southeast, Togo and Ghana to the south, and Ivory Coast to the southwest.

items.title: Mali
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Mali, officially the Republic of Mali, is a landlocked country in West Africa. It is the eighth-largest country in Africa and the 23rd largest country in the world, with an area of 1,240,192 square kilometres (478,841 sq mi).

items.title: Romania
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Romania is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe. It lies on the lower course of the Danube, north of the Balkan Peninsula, and on the northwestern shore of the Black Sea.

items.title: Chile
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Chile, officially the Republic of Chile, is a country in the Southern Cone of southwestern South America. It is the southernmost country in the world and the closest to Antarctica, extending along a narrow strip of land between the Andes Mountains and the Pacific Ocean.

items.title: Malawi
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Malawi, officially the Republic of Malawi, is a landlocked country in Southeast Africa. It is bordered by Zambia to the west, Tanzania to the north and northeast, and Mozambique to the east, south, and southwest.

items.title: Kazakhstan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Kazakhstan, officially the Republic of Kazakhstan, is a landlocked country situated primarily in Central Asia, with a portion of its territory extending into Eastern Europe.

items.title: Zambia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

items.fact: Zambia, officially the Republic of Zambia, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa.

items.title: Ecuador
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ecuador, officially the Republic of Ecuador, is a country in northwestern South America, bordered by Colombia on the north, Peru on the east and south, and the Pacific Ocean on the west.

items.title: Syria
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Syria, officially the Syrian Arab Republic, is a country in West Asia located in the Eastern Mediterranean and the Levant. It borders the Mediterranean Sea to the west, Turkey to the north and northwest, Iraq to the east and southeast, Jordan to the south, and Israel and Lebanon to the southwest.

items.title: Guatemala
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Guatemala, officially the Republic of Guatemala, is a country in northern Central America. It is bordered to the north and west by Mexico, to the northeast (in the adjacency zone) by Belize, to the east by Honduras, and to the southeast by El Salvador.

items.title: Cambodia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Cambodia, officially the Kingdom of Cambodia, is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Thailand to the northwest, Laos to the north, and Vietnam to the east, and has a coastline along the Gulf of Thailand in the southwest.

items.title: Senegal
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Senegal, officially the Republic of Senegal, is the westernmost country of mainland West Africa, situated along the Atlantic Ocean coast. It borders Mauritania to the north, Mali to the east, Guinea to the southeast and Guinea-Bissau to the southwest.

items.title: Chad
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Chad, officially the Republic of Chad, is a landlocked country in Central Africa. It is bordered by Libya to the north, Sudan to the east, the Central African Republic to the south, Cameroon to the southwest, Nigeria to the southwest (at Lake Chad), and Niger to the west.

items.title: Zimbabwe
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Zimbabwe, officially the Republic of Zimbabwe, is a landlocked country in Southeast Africa, between the Zambezi and Limpopo River, bordered by South Africa to the south, Botswana to the southwest, Zambia to the north, and Mozambique to the east. The capital and largest city is Harare, and the second largest is Bulawayo.

items.title: Guinea
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Guinea, officially the Republic of Guinea, is a coastal country located in West Africa. It borders the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Guinea-Bissau to the northwest, Senegal to the north, Mali to the northeast, Ivory Coast to the southeast, and Sierra Leone and Liberia to the south.

items.title: Rwanda
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

borders: the Democratic Republic of the Congo
bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: Rwanda, officially the Republic of Rwanda, is a landlocked country in East Africa. Its geography is dominated by mountains in the west and savanna in the southeast.

items.title: Benin
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Benin, officially the Republic of Benin, formerly known as Dahomey, is a country in West Africa. It is bordered by Togo to the west, Nigeria to the east, Burkina Faso to the northwest, and Niger to the northeast.

items.title: Tunisia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Tunisia, officially the Republic of Tunisia, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It is bordered by Algeria to the west and southwest, Libya to the southeast, and the Mediterranean Sea to the north and east.

items.title: Burundi
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: Burundi, officially the Republic of Burundi, is a landlocked country in East Africa. It is located in the Great Rift Valley at the junction between the African Great Lakes region and southeastern Africa, with a population of over 14 million people.

items.title: Bolivia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Bolivia, officially the Plurinational State of Bolivia, is a landlocked country located in central South America. Its geography primarily consists of an Andean region to the west and tropical lowlands to the east and north.

items.title: Belgium
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Belgium, officially the Kingdom of Belgium, is a country in Northwestern Europe. Situated in a coastal lowland region known as the Low Countries, it is bordered by the Netherlands to the north, Germany to the east, Luxembourg to the southeast, France to the south, and the North Sea to the west.

items.title: Cuba
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Cuba, officially the Republic of Cuba, is an island country in the Caribbean. It comprises the eponymous main island as well as 4,195 islands, islets, and cays.

items.title: Haiti
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Haiti, officially the Republic of Haiti, is a country in the Caribbean on the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean Sea, east of Cuba and Jamaica and south of The Bahamas. It occupies the western side of the island, which it shares with the Dominican Republic.

items.title: South Sudan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

borders: the Democratic Republic of the Congo
bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: South Sudan, officially the Republic of South Sudan, is a landlocked country in East Africa. It is bordered by Sudan to the north, Ethiopia to the east, Kenya to the southeast, Uganda to the south, the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the southwest, and the Central African Republic to the west.

items.title: the Dominican Republic
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The Dominican Republic is an island country on the eastern part of the Caribbean island of Hispaniola in the Greater Antilles of the Caribbean Sea in the North Atlantic Ocean.

items.title: Greece
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Greece, officially the Hellenic Republic, is a country located mostly on the Balkan peninsula of Southeastern Europe, with thousands of islands extending geographically to Asia Minor. It has a population of around 10 million.

items.title: the Czech Republic
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The Czech Republic, also known as Czechia and historically known as Bohemia, is a landlocked country in Central Europe. The country is bordered by Austria to the south, Germany to the west, Poland to the northeast, and Slovakia to the southeast.

items.title: Sweden
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Sweden, formally the Kingdom of Sweden, is a Nordic country located on the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe. It borders Norway to the west and north, and Finland to the east, and shares a maritime border with Denmark to the south.

items.title: Portugal
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Portugal, officially the Portuguese Republic, is a country in Southwestern Europe. Mainland Portugal is located on the southwestern portion of the Iberian Peninsula, and bordered by Spain to the north and east.

items.title: Somalia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Somalia, officially the Federal Republic of Somalia, is the easternmost country in continental Africa. Stretching across the Horn of Africa, it borders Ethiopia to the west, Djibouti to the northwest, Kenya to the southwest, the Gulf of Aden to the north, and the Indian Ocean to the east.

items.title: Jordan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Jordan, officially the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. Jordan is bordered by Syria to the north, Iraq to the east, Saudi Arabia to the south, and both Israel and Palestine (West Bank) to the west.

items.title: Azerbaijan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Azerbaijan, officially the Republic of Azerbaijan, is a landlocked country at the boundary of Western Asia and Eastern Europe.

items.title: the United Arab Emirates
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: The United Arab Emirates (UAE), also known simply as the Emirates, is a country in West Asia, situated at the eastern end of the Arabian Peninsula. It is a federal semi-constitutional monarchy made up of seven emirates, with Abu Dhabi serving as its national capital.

items.title: Hungary
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Hungary is a landlocked country in Central Europe. Spanning much of the Carpathian Basin, it is bordered by Slovakia to the north, Ukraine to the northeast, Romania to the east and southeast, Serbia to the south, Croatia and Slovenia to the southwest, and Austria to the west.

items.title: Honduras
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Honduras, officially the Republic of Honduras, is a country in Central America. It is bordered to the west by Guatemala, to the southwest by El Salvador, to the southeast by Nicaragua, to the south by the Pacific Ocean at the Gulf of Fonseca, and to the north by the Gulf of Honduras, a large inlet of the Caribbean Sea.

items.title: Belarus
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Belarus, officially the Republic of Belarus, is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. It is bordered by Russia to the east and northeast, Ukraine to the south, Poland to the west, and Lithuania and Latvia to the northwest.

items.title: Tajikistan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Tajikistan, officially the Republic of Tajikistan, is a landlocked country in Central Asia. Dushanbe, its capital, is its largest and most populous city, with a population of over 1.2 million.

items.title: Israel
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Israel, officially the State of Israel, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. It is bordered by Lebanon to the north, Syria to the northeast, Jordan to the east, and Egypt to the southwest.

items.title: Austria
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Austria, formally the Republic of Austria, is a landlocked country in Central Europe, lying in the Eastern Alps. It is a federation of nine states, of which the capital Vienna is the most populous city and state.

items.title: Papua New Guinea
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Papua New Guinea (PNG), officially the Independent State of Papua New Guinea, is an island nation in Oceania that comprises the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia, a region of the southwestern Pacific Ocean north of Australia.

items.title: Switzerland
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Switzerland, officially the Swiss Confederation, is a landlocked country located at the intersection of Central, Western, and Southern Europe. It is bordered by Germany to the north, France to the west, Austria and Liechtenstein to the east, and Italy to the south.

items.title: Togo
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Togo, officially the Togolese Republic, is a country located in West Africa. It is bordered by Ghana to the west, Benin to the east and Burkina Faso to the north.

items.title: Sierra Leone
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Sierra Leone, officially the Republic of Sierra Leone, is a country on the west coast of West Africa. It is bordered to the southeast by Liberia and by Guinea to the north.

items.title: Laos
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Laos, officially the Lao People's Democratic Republic (LPDR), is a country in Mainland Southeast Asia, and the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia. It is bordered by Myanmar and China to the northwest, Vietnam to the east, Cambodia to the southeast, and Thailand to the west and southwest.

items.title: Paraguay
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Paraguay, officially the Republic of Paraguay, is a landlocked country located in the central region of South America. It borders Bolivia to the northwest and north, Brazil to the northeast and east, and Argentina to the southeast, south, and west.

items.title: Bulgaria
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Bulgaria, officially the Republic of Bulgaria, is a country in Southeastern Europe. It is situated on the eastern portion of the Balkans directly south of the Danube river and west of the Black Sea.

items.title: Serbia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Serbia, officially the Republic of Serbia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern and Central Europe.

items.title: Lebanon
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Lebanon, officially the Lebanese Republic, is a country in the Levant region of West Asia. Situated at the crossroads of the Mediterranean Basin and the Arabian Peninsula, it is bordered by Syria to the north and east, Israel to the south, and the Mediterranean Sea to the west; Cyprus lies a short distance from the coastline.

items.title: Libya
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Libya, officially the State of Libya, is a country in the Maghreb region of North Africa. It borders the Mediterranean Sea to the north, Egypt to the east, Sudan to the southeast, Chad to the south, Niger to the southwest, Algeria to the west, and Tunisia to the northwest.

items.title: Nicaragua
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Nicaragua, officially the Republic of Nicaragua, is a country in Central America, comprising 130,370 square kilometers (50,340 sq mi). With a population of 7,097,329 as of 2026, it is the third-most populous country in Central America after Guatemala and Honduras, and the largest by area in all of Central America.

items.title: Kyrgyzstan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Kyrgyzstan, officially the Kyrgyz Republic, formerly known as Kirghizia, is a landlocked country located in Central Asia, lying in the Tian Shan and Pamir mountain ranges. It is bordered by Kazakhstan to the north, Uzbekistan to the west, Tajikistan to the south, and China to the east and southeast.

items.title: El Salvador
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: El Salvador, officially the Republic of El Salvador, is a sovereign nation in Central America. Situated along the Pacific coast, it is bounded by Guatemala to the northwest and Honduras to the northeast.

items.title: Eritrea
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Eritrea, officially the State of Eritrea, is a country in the Horn of Africa region of East Africa. Its capital and largest city is Asmara.

items.title: Turkmenistan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Turkmenistan is a landlocked country in Central Asia, bordered by Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan to the north, Afghanistan to the southeast, Iran to the south and southwest, and the Caspian Sea to the west. It is one of six independent Turkic states.

items.title: Singapore
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Singapore, officially the Republic of Singapore, is an island country in Southeast Asia. Its territory comprises a main island, over 60 satellite islands and islets, and one outlying islet.

items.title: Finland
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Finland, officially the Republic of Finland, is a Nordic country in Northern Europe. It borders Sweden to the northwest, Norway to the north, and Russia to the east, with the Gulf of Bothnia to the west and the Gulf of Finland to the south, opposite Estonia.

items.title: Slovakia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Slovakia, officially the Slovak Republic, is a landlocked country in Central Europe. It is bordered by Poland to the north, Ukraine to the east, Hungary to the south, Austria to the west, and the Czech Republic to the northwest.

items.title: the Republic of the Congo
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

borders: the Democratic Republic of the Congo
bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: The Republic of the Congo, also known as the Congo Republic, Congo-Brazzaville, or simply the Congo, is a country located on the western coast of Central Africa to the west of the Congo River.

items.title: Norway
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Norway, officially the Kingdom of Norway, is a Nordic country comprising the western and northernmost parts of the Scandinavian Peninsula in Northern Europe, the remote Arctic island Jan Mayen and the archipelago Svalbard.

items.title: Costa Rica
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Costa Rica, officially the Republic of Costa Rica, is a country in Central America. It borders Nicaragua to the north, the Caribbean Sea to the northeast, Panama to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the southwest, sharing a maritime border with Ecuador to the south of Cocos Island.

items.title: Oman
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Oman, officially the Sultanate of Oman, is a country in the southeastern Arabian Peninsula in West Asia. It shares land borders with Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Yemen, and maritime borders with Iran and Pakistan.

items.title: Ireland
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ireland, also known as the Republic of Ireland (Poblacht na hÉireann), is a country in Northwestern Europe. It consists of 26 of the 32 counties of the island of Ireland, with a population of about 5.4 million.

items.title: Liberia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Liberia, officially the Republic of Liberia, is a country on the West African coast. It is bordered by Sierra Leone to its northwest, Guinea to its north, Ivory Coast to its east, and the Atlantic Ocean to its south and southwest.

items.title: New Zealand
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: New Zealand is an island country in the southwestern Pacific Ocean. It comprises two main landmasses—the North Island (Te Ika-a-Māui) and the South Island (Te Waipounamu)—and over 700 smaller islands.

items.title: the Central African Republic
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth

borders: the Democratic Republic of the Congo
bordersAny: the Democratic Republic of the Congo

items.fact: The Central African Republic (CAR) is a landlocked country in Central Africa. It is bordered by Chad to the north, Sudan to the northeast, South Sudan to the east, the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the south, the Republic of the Congo to the southwest, and Cameroon to the west.

items.title: Mauritania
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Mauritania, officially the Islamic Republic of Mauritania, is a country in the Maghreb region of West Africa. It is bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Western Sahara to the north and northwest, Algeria to the northeast, Mali to the east and southeast, and Senegal to the southwest.

items.title: Panama
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Panama, officially the Republic of Panama, is a country located at the southern end of Central America in North America, bordering South America. It is bordered by Costa Rica to the west, Colombia to the southeast, the Caribbean Sea to the north, and the Pacific Ocean to the south.

items.title: Kuwait
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Kuwait, officially the State of Kuwait, is a country in West Asia. With a coastline of approximately 500 km (311 mi), it is situated at the head of the Persian Gulf in the northeastern edge of the Arabian Peninsula, bordering Iraq to the north and Saudi Arabia to the south.

items.title: Croatia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Croatia, officially the Republic of Croatia, is a country in Central and Southeastern Europe, on the coast of the Adriatic Sea. It borders Slovenia to the northwest, Hungary to the northeast, Serbia to the east, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Montenegro to the southeast, and shares a maritime border with Italy to the west.

items.title: Georgia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Georgia is a country in the Caucasus region on the east coast of the Black Sea. It is located at the intersection of Eastern Europe and West Asia and is generally regarded as part of Europe.

items.title: Uruguay
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Uruguay, officially the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, is a country in southeastern South America. It shares borders with Argentina to its west and southwest and Brazil to its north and northeast, while bordering the Río de la Plata to the south and the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast.

items.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Bosnia and Herzegovina, often referred to as Bosnia-Herzegovina or simply Bosnia, is a country in Southeastern Europe. Situated on the Balkan Peninsula, it borders Serbia to the east, Montenegro to the southeast, and Croatia to the north and southwest, with a 20-kilometre-long (12-mile) coast on the Adriatic Sea in the south.

items.title: Mongolia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia.

items.title: Armenia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Armenia, officially the Republic of Armenia, is a landlocked country in the Armenian highlands of West Asia. It is a part of the Caucasus region and is bordered by Turkey to the west, Georgia to the north, Azerbaijan to the east, and Iran and the Azerbaijani exclave of Nakhchivan to the south.

items.title: Jamaica
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean, covering 10,991 square kilometres (4,244 sq mi). It is the third-largest island in the Greater Antilles and the Caribbean, after Cuba and the island of Hispaniola.

items.title: Albania
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Albania, officially the Republic of Albania, is a country in Southeastern Europe. It is located in the Balkans, on the Adriatic and Ionian Seas within the Mediterranean Sea, and shares land borders with Montenegro to the northwest, Kosovo to the northeast, North Macedonia to the east and Greece to the south.

items.title: Qatar
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Qatar, officially the State of Qatar, is a country in West Asia. It occupies the Qatar Peninsula on the northeastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula in the Middle East; it shares its sole land border with Saudi Arabia to the south, with the rest of its territory surrounded by the Persian Gulf.

items.title: Lithuania
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Lithuania, officially the Republic of Lithuania, is a country in the Baltic region of Europe.

items.title: Iceland
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Iceland is a Nordic island country between the Arctic Ocean and the North Atlantic Ocean, located on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge between Europe and North America. It is Europe's westernmost and most sparsely populated country.

items.title: Estonia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Estonia, officially the Republic of Estonia, is a country in the Baltic region of Northern Europe. It is bordered to the north by the Gulf of Finland across from Finland, to the west by the Baltic Sea across from Sweden, to the south by Latvia, and to the east by Russia.

items.title: Latvia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Latvia, officially the Republic of Latvia, is a country in the Baltic region of northern Europe. It is one of the three Baltic states, along with Estonia to the north and Lithuania to the south.

items.title: Slovenia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Slovenia, officially the Republic of Slovenia, is a country in Central Europe. It borders Italy to its west, Austria to its north, Hungary to its northeast, and Croatia to its south and southeast; its southwestern boundary consists of a 46.6-kilometre (29.0 mi) coastline on the Adriatic Sea.

items.title: North Macedonia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: North Macedonia, officially the Republic of North Macedonia, is a landlocked country in Southeastern Europe. It shares borders with Greece to the south, Albania to the west, Bulgaria to the east, Kosovo to the northwest and Serbia to the north.

items.title: Montenegro
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Montenegro is a country in Southeastern Europe, on the Balkan Peninsula. Its 25 municipalities have a total population of 633,158 people in an area of 13,883 km2 (5,360 sq mi).

items.title: Cyprus
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Cyprus, officially the Republic of Cyprus, is an island country in the eastern Mediterranean Sea, located off the coast of the Levant mainland in West Asia.

items.title: Botswana
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Botswana, officially the Republic of Botswana, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa. Botswana is topographically flat, with approximately 70% of its territory being a part of the Kalahari Desert.

items.title: Namibia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Namibia, officially the Republic of Namibia, is a country in Southern Africa.

items.title: Luxembourg
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Luxembourg, officially the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, is a landlocked country in Western Europe. It is bordered by Belgium to the west and north, Germany to the east, and France to the south and west.

items.title: Fiji
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Fiji, officially the Republic of Fiji, is an archipelagic country in Melanesia, part of Oceania in the South Pacific Ocean. It lies about 1,100 nautical miles (2,000 km; 1,300 mi) north-northeast of New Zealand.

items.title: Alaska
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Alaska is a U.S. state located in the northwestern regions of North America.

items.title: Alabama
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Alabama is a state in the Southeastern and Deep Southern regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the north, Georgia to the east, Florida and the Gulf of Mexico to the south, and Mississippi to the west.

items.title: Arkansas
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Arkansas is a landlocked state in the West South Central region of the Southern United States. It borders Missouri to the north, Tennessee and Mississippi to the east, Louisiana to the south, Texas to the southwest, and Oklahoma to the west.

items.title: Arizona
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Arizona is a landlocked state in the Southwestern United States, sharing the Four Corners region with Colorado, New Mexico, and Utah. It also borders Nevada to the northwest and California to the west, and shares an international border with the Mexican states of Sonora and Baja California to the south and southwest.

items.title: California
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: California is a state in the Western United States. It is bordered by Oregon to the north, the Mexican state of Baja California to the south, Nevada to the east, Arizona to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the west.

items.title: Colorado
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Colorado is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is part of the Southwestern United States, sharing the Four Corners region with Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah.

items.title: Connecticut
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Connecticut is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Rhode Island to the east, Massachusetts to the north, New York to the west, and Long Island Sound to the south.

items.title: Delaware
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Delaware is a state in the Mid-Atlantic and South Atlantic regions of the United States. It borders Maryland to its south and west, Pennsylvania to its north, New Jersey to its northeast, and the Atlantic Ocean to its east.

items.title: Florida
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Florida is a state in the Southeastern and South Atlantic regions of the United States. It borders the Gulf of Mexico to the west, Alabama to the northwest, Georgia to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the east, the Straits of Florida to the south, and The Bahamas to the southeast.

items.title: Georgia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Georgia is a state in the Southeastern, South Atlantic, and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the northwest, North Carolina and South Carolina to the northeast, the Atlantic Ocean to the east, Florida to the south, and Alabama to the west.

items.title: Hawaii
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Hawaii is an island state of the United States, in the Pacific Ocean about 2,000 miles (3,200 km) southwest of the U.S. mainland.

items.title: Iowa
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Iowa is a landlocked state in the upper Midwestern region of the United States.

items.title: Idaho
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Idaho is a landlocked state in the Pacific Northwest and Mountain West subregions of the Western United States.

items.title: Illinois
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Illinois ( IL-ih-NOY) is a state in the Midwestern United States. It borders on Lake Michigan to its northeast, the Wabash and Ohio rivers to its south, and the Mississippi River generally to its west.

items.title: Indiana
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Indiana is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders Lake Michigan to the northwest, Michigan to the north and northeast, Ohio to the east, the Ohio River and Kentucky to the south and southeast, and the Wabash River and Illinois to the west.

items.title: Kansas
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Kansas is a landlocked state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders Nebraska to the north, Colorado to the west, Oklahoma to the south, and Missouri to the east.

items.title: Kentucky
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Kentucky, officially the Commonwealth of Kentucky, is a landlocked state in the Southeastern region of the United States. It borders Illinois, Indiana, and Ohio to the north, West Virginia to the northeast, Virginia to the east, Tennessee to the south, and Missouri to the west.

items.title: Louisiana
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Louisiana is a state in the Deep South and South Central regions of the United States. It is bordered by Texas to the west, Arkansas to the north, and Mississippi to the east.

items.title: Massachusetts
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Massachusetts, officially the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States.

items.title: Maryland
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Maryland is a state in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern regions of the United States. It borders Virginia to its south, West Virginia to its west, Pennsylvania to its north, and Delaware to its east, as well as with the Atlantic Ocean to its east, and the national capital and federal district of Washington, D.C. to the southwest.

items.title: Maine
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Maine ( MAYN) is a state in the New England region of the United States, and the northeasternmost state in the contiguous United States.

items.title: Michigan
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Michigan is a peninsular state in the Great Lakes region of the Upper Midwestern United States. It shares water and land boundaries with Minnesota to the northwest, Wisconsin to the west, Indiana and Illinois to the southwest, Ohio to the southeast, and the Canadian province of Ontario to the east, northeast and north.

items.title: Minnesota
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Minnesota is a state in the Upper Midwestern region of the United States. It is bordered by the Canadian provinces of Manitoba and Ontario to the north and east and by the U.S. states of Wisconsin to the east, Iowa to the south, and North Dakota and South Dakota to the west.

items.title: Missouri
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Missouri (see pronunciation) is a landlocked state in the Midwestern region of the United States. Ranking 21st in land area, it borders Iowa to the north, Illinois, Kentucky and Tennessee to the east, Arkansas to the south and Oklahoma, Kansas, and Nebraska to the west.

items.title: Mississippi
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Mississippi ( MISS-iss-IP-ee) is a state in the Southeastern and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the north, Alabama to the east, the Gulf of Mexico to the south, Louisiana to the southwest, and Arkansas to the northwest.

items.title: Montana
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Montana is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is bordered by Idaho to the west, North Dakota to the east, South Dakota to the southeast, Wyoming to the south, and the Canadian provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan to the north.

items.title: North Carolina
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: North Carolina is a state in the Southeastern and South Atlantic regions of the United States. It is bordered by Virginia to the north, the Atlantic Ocean to the east, South Carolina to the south, Georgia to the southwest, and Tennessee to the west.

items.title: North Dakota
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: North Dakota is a landlocked U.S. state in the Upper Midwest, named after the indigenous Dakota and Sioux peoples.

items.title: Nebraska
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Nebraska is a landlocked state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders South Dakota to the north; Wyoming to the west; Colorado to the southwest; Kansas to the south; and Missouri to the southeast and Iowa to the east, both across the Missouri River.

items.title: New Hampshire
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: New Hampshire is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, Vermont to the west, Maine and the Gulf of Maine to the east, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.

items.title: New Jersey
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: New Jersey is a state located in both the Mid-Atlantic and Northeastern regions of the United States.

items.title: New Mexico
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: New Mexico is a landlocked state in the Southwestern region of the United States. It is one of the Mountain States of the southern Rocky Mountains, sharing the Four Corners region with Utah, Colorado, and Arizona.

items.title: Nevada
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Nevada is a landlocked state in the Western United States. It is also sometimes placed in the Mountain West and Southwestern United States.

items.title: New York
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: New York, also called New York State, is a state located in the Northeastern United States. Bordering New England to its east, Pennsylvania and New Jersey to the south, and Canada to its north, New York extends into both the Atlantic Ocean and the Great Lakes.

items.title: Ohio
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Ohio ( oh-HY-oh) is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders the Canadian province of Ontario to the north (through Lake Erie), Pennsylvania to the east, West Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, Indiana to the west, and Michigan to the northwest.

items.title: Oklahoma
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Oklahoma, is a landlocked state in the South Central, Southern, and Southwestern regions of the United States. It borders Texas to the southwest, Kansas to the north, Missouri to the northeast, Arkansas to the southeast, New Mexico to the west, and Colorado to the northwest.

items.title: Oregon
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Oregon is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is a part of the Western United States, with the Columbia River delineating much of Oregon's northern boundary with Washington, while the Snake River delineates much of its eastern boundary with Idaho.

items.title: Pennsylvania
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Pennsylvania, officially the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, is a state located in the Mid-Atlantic, Northeastern, Appalachian, and Great Lakes regions of the United States.

items.title: Rhode Island
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Rhode Island ( ROHD) is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Connecticut to its west; Massachusetts to its north and east; and the Atlantic Ocean to its south via Rhode Island Sound and Block Island Sound; and shares a small maritime border with New York, east of Long Island.

items.title: South Carolina
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: South Carolina is a state in the Southeastern, South Atlantic and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders North Carolina to the north and northeast, the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast, and Georgia to the west and south across the Savannah River.

items.title: South Dakota
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: South Dakota is a landlocked state in the North Central region of the United States. It is also part of the Great Plains.

items.title: Tennessee
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Tennessee (locally), officially the State of Tennessee, is a landlocked state in the Southeastern region of the United States. It borders Kentucky to the north, Virginia to the northeast, North Carolina to the east, Georgia, Alabama, and Mississippi to the south, Arkansas to the southwest, and Missouri to the northwest.

items.title: Texas
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Texas is a state in the United States. Located in the south-central part of the country, it borders Louisiana, Arkansas, Oklahoma, and New Mexico.

items.title: Utah
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Utah is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is one of the Four Corners states, sharing a border with Arizona, Colorado, and New Mexico.

items.title: Virginia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Virginia, officially the Commonwealth of Virginia, is a state in the Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States between the Atlantic Coast and the Appalachian Mountains. It borders Kentucky to the west, Tennessee to the south-west, North Carolina to the south, West Virginia to the north-west, and Maryland to the north.

items.title: Vermont
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Vermont is a landlocked state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, New Hampshire to the east, New York to the west, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.

items.title: Washington
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Washington is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is often referred to as Washington state to distinguish it from the national capital; both are named after George Washington, a U.S. Founding Father and the first U.S. president.

items.title: Wisconsin
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Wisconsin is a state in the Upper Midwest and Great Lakes regions of the United States. It borders Minnesota to the west, Iowa to the southwest, Illinois to the south, Lake Michigan to the east, Michigan to the northeast, and Lake Superior to the north.

items.title: West Virginia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: West Virginia is a mountainous, landlocked state in the Southern and Mid-Atlantic regions of the United States. It is bordered by Pennsylvania and Maryland to the northeast, Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, and Ohio to the northwest.

items.title: Wyoming
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.fact: Wyoming ( wy-OH-ming) is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It borders Montana to the north and northwest, South Dakota and Nebraska to the east, Idaho to the west, Utah to the southwest, and Colorado to the south.

items.title: the Soviet Union
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.group: a country that no longer exists (1922–1991)
items.fact: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991. It was the world's third-most populous country, the largest by area, and bordered twelve other countries.

items.title: Yugoslavia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.group: a country that no longer exists (1945–1992)
items.fact: The Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, known from 1945 to 1963 as the Federal People's Republic of Yugoslavia, and commonly referred to as Yugoslavia, was a country in Central and Southeast Europe. It was established in 1945, following World War II, and lasted until 1992, dissolving amid the onset of the Yugoslav Wars.

items.title: Czechoslovakia
items.credit: Drawn for Time Rolls from Natural Earth
items.group: a country that no longer exists (1918–1992)
items.fact: Czechoslovakia was a country in Central Europe. The country was bordered by Austria and Hungary to the south, Germany to the west and northwest, Poland to the northeast, and Ukraine to the southeast.
